name: TorchlightMC
description:
We are a PVE centered and protected crossplay server. We have proximity voice and a discord for communication. We have a few light cosmetics in our webshop but do not sell anything gamebreaking or unfair. We are all about adventure, building and community. PVP, traps, and griefing are blocked except in designated areas.

If this sounds like it is for you then let Torchlight guide you home.
